description:
Merge every visible layer into one layer. Hidden layers stay in the stack.

Use when: the user wants visible layers combined and hidden layers kept.
Do NOT use when: every layer, including hidden ones, should become a single Background — use photoshop_flatten_image.
Do NOT use when: only two named layers should combine — this always merges all visible layers.

Returns: confirmation that visible layers were merged.
Preconditions: active document with at least one visible layer. Side effects: destroys the separate visible layers in one history step. Reversible with photoshop_undo.

document_id.description: Optional Photoshop document id from photoshop_get_state / photoshop_list_documents. When set, the tool activates that document before running so a UI tab switch cannot retarget the edit.

name: photoshop_merge_visible_layers
